Package aor.proj3t.service.impl

Class NotificationServiceImpl

java.lang.Object
aor.proj3t.service.impl.BaseService
aor.proj3t.service.impl.NotificationServiceImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
NotificationService
@ApplicationScoped public class NotificationServiceImpl extends BaseService implements NotificationService
Implementation of the NotificationService interface. This service manages all notification-related operations including creation, retrieval, marking as read, and real-time WebSocket notifications to users.

Key functionalities include:

  • Creating and persisting notifications
  • Sending real-time WebSocket notifications
  • Marking notifications as read with timestamps
  • Retrieving paginated notification lists for users
  • Converting between entity and DTO representations

This service integrates with WebSocket services to provide real-time notification delivery to connected users.

      public Notification createNotification(Notification notification)
